about:
Keystone Solutions Group operates from Kalamazoo, Michigan, where it has provided medical device contract manufacturing services for more than 25 years. The company is led by President Jim Medsker and a leadership team that includes VP of Sales and Business Development Jason Barr, VP of Engineering Vaughn Gerber, and Director of Quality & Regulatory William Reinholt.

The firm specializes in assembly, kitting, packaging, converting, and sterilization management, supporting programs from prototype and pilot builds through full-scale production. Its capabilities include multiple clean room environments, supply chain sourcing, warehousing, and distribution. The team of engineers, program leads, and production specialists manages end-to-end manufacturing of single-use disposable and reusable medical products.

Keystone serves the medical device industry worldwide, working with customers ranging from start-ups to established OEMs. Its Customer Product Transfer Process handles project planning through commercial release, addressing regulatory, intellectual property, and commercial challenges that arise during product launch.

The company emphasizes a collaborative approach that goes beyond typical OEM/contract manufacturer relationships, offering complete end-to-end solutions from concept through approval and production. Its differentiators include in-house sterilization validation expertise, clean room qualification, and a quality system aligned with ISO 13485 and FDA QSR requirements.
